title: xDrip follower sees compressed bg scale if on mmol/l while master on mg/dl
symptom: When a follower uses mmol/l while the master records mg/dl, the bg scale appears compressed (by a factor of 18) because treatment y values are not scaled, causing entries with bg values in the 100-150 range to compress the real bg range.
cause: Treatment y values are not scaled when the follower uses mmol/l while the master uses mg/dl.
evidence_quote: Apparently treatment y values aren't scaled.
